title: [Roadmap] CLI Improvements
body:
## Summary
A series of CLI improvements are needed to improve the developer experience and decrease the learning curve.

## Deliverables
Based on the first hackathon, we've gathered a list of improvements to the CLI

- [x] Allow starting a project in the current folder.
- [x] Add a default .gitignore file when initializing a project.
- [x] Provide an example page or endpoint to verify if the server is running. /health-check
- [x] Automate dependency installation when creating project and nodes.
- [x] Improve the language of the CLI commands (linguistics) 
- [x] Fix TypeScript error when creating nodes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Testing the updated CLI with the participants of the hackathon to validate the improvements

comments.body:
Projects

```
# Create a project following the instructions & using the name "demo1"
npx nanoctl@latest create project
cd demo1

# Create a project providing the default name
npx nanoctl@latest create project --name demo1
cd demo1

# Create a project in an existing directory
mkdir demo1
cd demo1
npx nanoctl@latest create project .
```

Nodes
```
# Create a node following the instructions & using the name "node1"
npx nanoctl@latest create node
cd src/nodes/node1

# Create a node providing the default name
npx nanoctl@latest create node --name node1
cd src/nodes/node1

# Create a node in an existing directory
cd src/nodes
mkdir node1
cd node1
npx nanoctl@latest create node .
```
